byte_materialization_rule: All source SHA-256 values and sizes are computed from canonical Git blob bytes. Windows worktree files are not used as transfer bytes because line-ending filters may change their physical bytes.

files.logical_source: E0 overlay inferred by source aggregate plus current execution authority

delta_files.registered_hash_binding_note: No legacy file SHA-256 was declared. The recorded SHA-256 is the current authority binding for resolved raw bytes; the registered size is derived solely from the stale aggregate.

byte_authority.base_bytes: CURRENT_CANONICAL_BYTES: the current Git tree has every registered base blob unchanged.
byte_authority.overlay_bytes: CURRENT_CANONICAL_BYTES: canonical Git blob SHA-256 equals e0_execution_authority.execution_source_hashes.
byte_authority.aggregate_metadata: STALE_REGISTERED_METADATA: declared total subtracts 46 bytes from the sole hash-bound overlay without a legacy file hash or Git source.
byte_authority.historical_alternative: UNAVAILABLE_AND_NOT_AUTHORIZED: all-ref and reflog history expose no different overlay blob; no external source authority names one.
